meta.disclaimer: National definitions and collection methods differ widely. Time series are not comparable 1:1 across countries. The map headline sum is a sum of latest reported national estimates, not a global census total.
gaps: Most OECD HC3.1 countries publish a single latest-year headline here; multi-year series are included only where an official national time series was verified.
US HUD PIT 2021 national total omitted: pandemic disruptions meant a full comparable national (sheltered+unsheltered) total was not published the same way.
United Kingdom omitted from official country counts on the map (no clear unduplicated national person total in OECD HC3.1).
No official monthly national person totals published for Australia (ABS Census) or United States (HUD PIT) — chart months grain falls back to annual points.

series.name: Australia
series.definition: ABS Census estimating homelessness (Census night). ABS notes 2021 boarding-house / temporary-lodging groups are not fully comparable with earlier Censuses due to greater use of administrative data.

series.name: United States
series.definition: HUD Point-in-Time (PIT) count of people experiencing sheltered or unsheltered homelessness on a single night in January. Definitions differ from ABS/OECD.
